title: Simon Magus levitating and Peter and Paul

tellings.quote: you know there's a a biblical story of Simon of Maggus who uses like black magic to levitate and then he sees Peter and Paul

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells an early Christian legend about Simon Magus, a sorcerer who uses black magic to levitate, and then comes up against the apostles Peter and Paul. He brings it up as an old story of strange powers in the air and a clash between rival forces.
